I had hoped to be stationed in a larger city, with more to see and do. But I'm young, and I have plenty of time...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32220-09.html.text: Master Selsia: Recently, several high-ranking Human officials and Priests were killed by monsters while traveling through Death Pass to Oren Castle. There have also been cases of monsters nearby engaging in pillage and bandits attacking traders between Oren and Kiran... That is the official story, …

links.text: "Really? Do you think there is anything strange going on?"
I believe it is a raid by ordinary monsters, just as was publicly announced.
The travelers probably simply were in the wrong place at the wrong time.
But it seems less likely that the high-ranking officials would be so careless as to be ambushed.
Perhaps the flashy uniforms attracted the monsters' attention...

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32220-22.html.text: Master Selsia: This story about Beleth may have been made up by greedy Ivory Tower Wizard who wanted the Giants' Research Documents for themselves. The sticking point is whoever instructed the monsters to attack. In this case, Gauen may be telling the truth, Kaiena may be telling the truth, or both…

Q00066_CertifiedArbalester/32220-23.html.text: Master Selsia: Then Ivory Tower may have planned this entire situation in order to keep Giran and Oren from acquiring this power. In that case, either Gauen or Kaiena may be telling the truth, or... some other group may have decided to snatch the information for itself.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
